youtube_creator.description: A team dedicated to creating viral video content, scripts, and SEO strategies.

team_roles.goal: Generate 3 trending video topics based on user niche.
Write a full script with hooks, body, and CTA based on the selected idea.
Create image prompts for thumbnails and a shot-list storyboard.
Generate titles, tags, and description optimized for search.
Review all outputs for tone consistency, engagement potential, and adherence to user preferences.

legal_squad.description: A team for drafting contracts and checking compliance.

team_roles.goal: Draft initial contract terms based on user requirements.
Rewrite complex legal jargon into simple English.
Ensure no contradictions and full compliance.
